warning 1-1: Dont modify this file in anyway unless you really have to, this is where I put the tags.
warning 1-2: I put this here in case someone wanted to change it.
warning 2-1: This is used find the Categorical Removals items to remove from the loot table along with the ignored NBT properties.
warning 2-2: While some of them I use explicit checks, changing these might not have effects.
warning 2-3: Checks like isEdible, isArmor, isSword from minecraft.
warning 3-1: You can modify this file for example if you wanted to ignore certain types while it might not work.
warning 4-1: Tags lists are forge tags, Tags_clean is what I use if the item somehow bypassed forge tags.
warning 4-2: Contain in the item name, you can remove them if you think they are unsafe.
warning 5-1: The COMMON_NBT_KEYS list is a set of non-special NBT keys often present on standard items.
warning 5-2: They will be ignored when the GLM determines if an item is *truly special*.
warning 6-1: The COMMON_LOOT_FUNCTIONS list is used by the Base Loot Modifier (pre-generation).
warning 6-2: These are standard functions used to generate standard gear. If a table uses a function NOT on this list, the item is considered protected.
warning 7-1: Be careful, there are tagged loots! Some loots use tags to add random items.
warning 7-2: More specific tags (e.g. c:vegetables) can be added into these five main categories.
